_readme: Maps a location (or, for away games, an opponent) to a TeamSnap Venue +
Sub-Venue. TeamSnap's importer cannot create venues or sub-venues, and it
rejects any row that has a Venue with no Sub-Venue. So a location is only
written to the Venue/Sub-Venue columns when BOTH values below are filled in;
otherwise the exporter leaves them blank and names the site in Notes.
`venues` keys match a home location: the gym codes UG/LG from the school
master, their long names from the season schedule, and the calendar feed's
`opponents` keys match an opponent name in site/content/schedule/<season>.toml
and supply the venue for AWAY games. Away sub-venues are "Main Gym" unless a site is known to name its courts;
ours are Upper Gym / Lower Gym. An entry with a venue but no sub_venue falls
back to --away-sub-venue (default "Main Gym"). Unmapped sites are listed
in the exporter's warnings after every run.
